prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body dual-body portrait: left leg tier L1, right leg tier L2, collarbone boundary. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Filipina woman in pageant glam makeup — warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, long voluminous chestnut waves, a bright, confident pageant smile. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a bright beaded drop earring.

Physique: A towering tentpole USSBBW woman standing tall on long legs, never short or squat. Shoulders more than four times a normal woman's width, massive rounded deltoids, a colossal chest projecting past the shoulders, a broad heavy torso with a big round belly, no waist at all, hips as broad as the shoulders, her left thigh, only its very top near the hip, is part of the vessel above; her right thigh, down to just above the knee, is part of the vessel above.

Material body: below the collarbones — her whole chest, both arms, both hands, belly, hips, her left thigh, only its very top near the hip, is part of the vessel above, and her right thigh, down to just above the knee, is part of the vessel above — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass. The vessel is completely filled with clear emerald-green water from the collarbone line down through whichever leg parts remain part of the vessel, with no hollow space and no air gap anywhere inside it. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Both arms below the shoulder, both hands, and every finger and knuckle, are the same solid clear glass as the rest of the vessel, with no skin anywhere on them. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through the whole filled volume — passing beside and between both hands and every finger, rising through her whole chest up to the collarbone line itself, winding around both hips, and drifting through whichever thigh and leg sections remain glass, never crowding, always with open water around each one.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left leg transition: On the left leg, exactly at the very top of the thigh, near the hip, the glass vessel ends in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture — at that flat cut face, the full thickness of the glass wall and the clear water sealed inside it are visible edge-on, the cut always clean, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn, always the finish of a sculpture. Her real left leg is a separate thing entirely: it simply begins at that same height, flush against the cut face of the glass above it, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real leg, with real skin, real pores and fine grain, warm in tone, completely opaque, never itself cut, never marked, as if it had always continued naturally from there, the entire thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot all real.

Right leg transition: On the right leg, a little above the knee, the glass vessel ends in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture — at that flat cut face, the full thickness of the glass wall and the clear water sealed inside it are visible edge-on, the cut always clean, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn, always the finish of a sculpture. Her real right knee, calf and foot are a separate thing entirely: they simply begin at that same height, flush against the cut face of the glass above them, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real leg, with real skin, real pores and fine grain, warm in tone, completely opaque, never itself cut, never marked, as if it had always continued naturally from there.

Left leg (real): her real left thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot, natural skin texture. her real left foot stands in a real extreme platform stiletto sandal.

Right leg (real): her real right knee, calf, ankle and foot, natural skin texture. her real right foot stands in a real extreme platform stiletto sandal.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a hot neon pink on one side and a bright electric cyan on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle — glowing evenly, marked with a few thin dark vertical lines spaced evenly across it so the bending of those lines inside her material body is unmistakable, and a glossy dark floor beneath her feet.

Pose: standing tall, body angled 45 degrees, feet planted apart, her left hand (solid glass) resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand (solid glass) relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods her material body from behind, so pink light passes through one side and cyan light passes through the other, the vertical lines clearly visible bending inside the glass. A soft frontal light falls on her face, ears and any real leg parts. A thin cool rim light traces her whole figure. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
